games.name: Attack on Titan: Freedom War
games.desc:
This is a permadeath multiplayer campaign where soldiers and warriors fight for the control of the founding titan. Dying quickly is a common thing here, only the strong and lucky ones survive.

The campaign is not a exact recreation of the aot storyline, but a similar one. It's divided in multiple arcs that contain multiple stages. 

It’s recommended to test shifters/pvp in practice before playing the campaign.

Inspired by the anime/manga Attack on Titan.

games.name: The Labyrinth
games.desc:
There are mazes of all shapes and sizes.
Mazes can be built with corn, mirrors, or fences.
They'll lead you to a dead end with winding paths and twists. 

Of course, if you're lucky, it's possible to find an exit.

But one thing all mazes have in common is a sense of excitement, indecision, and a desperate desire to escape.

Will you be able to overcome the next maze? Are you brave enough to face the traps, monsters, and players in the dark realm along the way?

You can play solo or form a team with other players and use the resources you find to craft tools and weapons that will aid you on your journey through the labyrinth.

This game is based on The Maze Runner with a MMORPG touch to it.
